self.text: I’m Tal, a man in my early 30s from Turkey who loves restoring vintage bikes in my free time. I shoot with a Sony camera and enjoy a relaxed photo walk that keeps a fast pace. I’m happy to teach post‑processing and love taking portraits of each other. I don’t get into gear debates—just good shots. I’m free Saturday mornings for a quick session. When I’m not behind the lens, I’m tinkering with a motorcycle, a hobby that keeps me grounded. I enjoy the thrill of turning a rusted frame into a sleek ride, and it gives me a sense of satisfaction that I carry into my photography. I’m looking for a partner who shares a relaxed vibe, appreciates a quick pace, and doesn’t fuss over gear. Let’s capture moments together in the city’s hidden corners and enjoy the process of learning and growing side by side.
